posts.preview: As we continue with our parliamentary work in the region, and as time permits, it is important for SWAPO Party deployees to engage regularly with the regional party structures. There should be no gap between SWAPO Parliamentary deployees and the Party structures to ensure the smooth implementation of the SWAPO Party...

During lunch this afternoon, led by Cde Nekongo, we paid a courtesy visit to the SWAPO Party Regional Coordinator, Cde Josua, to touch base with the regional leadership and reaffirm our commitment to strengthening coordination between SWAPO Party Parliamentary Deployees and the Party structures
